 MILWAUKEE (WKOW) — The 2026 World Series Parade celebrating the Milwaukee Brewers will air on WKOW Friday. 
 The Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 on Wednesday to clinch Game 5 of the World Series, capturing the team's first title in franchise history. 
 Live coverage of the parade starts at 9:30 a.m. on 27.1 (ABC) and will continue until 1 p.m. The parade itself begins at 10 a.m. A livestream of the festivities is available at the top of this article. 
 Because of this, the following programs will not air on Friday: 
 Live with Kelly & Mark (second half hour)
 The View
 Wisconsin News Now at 11
 Justice for the People
 GMA 3
 The parade will start at the intersection of N. 4th Street and W. Wisconsin Avenue and go through downtown Milwaukee before concluding at Henry Maier Festival Park (HMFP). A rally will take place on the grounds at the conclusion of the parade. 
 The HMFP grounds will open at 8 a.m. Admission is free until capacity is reached. 
 Seats inside the American Family Insurance Amphitheater, where speeches will be held, are ticketed. 
 Road closures are scheduled to begin at 7 a.m., and officials expect traffic delays in the area.
